name: code-organizer
description: Code-organisation rules for TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, C#, PHP, Ruby, C and C++: a Stop hook runs deterministic checks (layout, names, parameters, nesting), a three-variant function tournament and a library digest, and the codemaster skill fixes what they find while following the project's own conventions first. Written in bash: it needs only bash, git and the standard POSIX tools, and fetches ast-grep by itself on first use.
